model.arbitrary_collision: original BHT ideal query/time exponent log2(|range|)/3 with at least |range|^(1/3) list entries
model.lifetime_composition: R*epsilon union bound requires a conditional epsilon after every prior adaptive transcript and does not convert a query exponent into such an epsilon
model.multi_target_preimage: ideal constant-success Grover/Boyer query scale (log2(|range|/T))/2; probability rows use min(1,(2q+1)^2*T/|range|) as an upper envelope and show the same expression as a small-angle estimate only at <=0.01
model.no_qram_collision_screen: CNS 2017 ideal soft-O query/time 2n/5, polynomial O(n) quantum memory and classical memory exponent n/5; n is instantiated as log2(|range|)
model.physical_runtime: illustrative serial conversion at 1000000000000 ideal oracle queries/second; not a hardware or Poseidon2 runtime estimate
model.qualification: generic ideal-function query benchmarks only; not a reduction, Poseidon2 analysis, proof-system bound or monetary-security claim
model.target_membership: multi-target query exponents assume unit-cost coherent membership in a complete usable-target table; raw bytes are reported but qRAM construction is not

bht_original.qualification: original sampled-list plus Grover construction; storage excludes indices, reversible lookup circuitry and fault tolerance

bht_sampled_list_tradeoff.parameter: for list memory M=|range|^s, setup M and Grover search sqrt(|range|/M) give query/time exponent max(s,(1-s)/2)
bht_sampled_list_tradeoff.qualification: conservative parameterization of the original BHT construction, not a physical low-memory implementation

cns_no_qram_collision_screen.qualification: ideal random-function soft-O screen without qRAM; nominal exponents substitute log2(p^limbs) for n and do not establish Poseidon2 or monetary security

illustrative_serial_unit_cost_runtime.qualification: query-model conversion only; one oracle query is not one CPU operation and no reversible Poseidon2/qRAM cost is included

usable_target_table.lookup_assumption: unit-cost coherent membership over all entries (qRAM/oracle); excludes addressing, loading, error correction and circuit gates
